# Privacy

Your wallet stays on your device. The only thing we keep is your email.

- **Your email, and nothing else.** To open the hosted app you enter an email
  address. It is stored in our contact list at Resend, our email provider, and
  used to tell you about Perks Ledger: beta news, card benefits that changed,
  and later the public launch, accounts and paid plans. We never sell or share it. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe,
  and you can ask us to delete the address at any time.
- **The sample wallet needs no email.** Looking around the sample stores
  nothing at all, not even on your device.
- **No bank logins, no passwords.** Perks Ledger never asks for card numbers or
  bank credentials.
- **Your wallet data stays in your browser.** Your cards, check-offs, offers and
  subscriptions live in your browser's `localStorage` on your device and are
  never sent to us or anyone else.
- **No analytics or trackers.** Pages load nothing from third parties. The
  signup goes to our own server at perksledger.vercel.app, which passes your
  email to Resend.
- **Backups are yours.** Export, Import and "Download app + data" produce files
  on your device that only you hold.
- **Feedback is opt-in.** Feedback, wrong-data and card-request links open your
  own mail app; nothing is sent unless you send it. Those emails go to
  mybbrllc@gmail.com and are used only to fix data and improve the app.
- **Caveat:** because wallet data is browser-local, clearing site data (or a
  browser purging unused sites) deletes it. The app reminds you to keep a
  backup.

Questions, or to delete your email from our list: mybbrllc@gmail.com.
Updated November 2026.
